_note: PRD FR-08 / v1.1 §2.9. Category-based only, never exact grams/dollars from a photo (PRD explicit non-goal). Maps classifier.internal_category -> schemas.RecoveryPotential (low | moderate | high | unknown). Categories with valuable recoverable metals/components (PCB, laptops, computer components) score higher; low-material-diversity items (cables, chargers, small appliances) score lower; packaging has no meaningful metal-recovery angle so it's 'unknown' rather than a fabricated 'low'.
